name: Linear
description: Linear agent webhook bridge for OpenClaw dev runs

devAgentId.description: Agent ID to handle Linear issues (default: 'dev')

linearWebhookSecret.description: Linear webhook signing secret for signature verification

linearApiKey.description: Linear OAuth token for posting activities and updating issues

linearOauthClientId.description: Linear OAuth client ID for code exchange/refresh

linearOauthClientSecret.description: Linear OAuth client secret for code exchange/refresh

linearOauthRedirectUri.description: Redirect URI configured in Linear app settings

linearTokenStorePath.description: Workspace-local path for persisted Linear OAuth tokens

notifyChannel.description: Optional channel to deliver agent responses (e.g., 'discord')

repoByTeam.description: Map Linear team keys to repository directories

repoByProject.description: Map Linear project keys to repository directories

defaultDir.description: Default repository directory when no team/project mapping matches

delegateOnCreate.description: Auto-delegate issues to the app user on session create (default: true)

startOnCreate.description: Move issues to 'started' state on session create (default: true)

externalUrlBase.description: Base URL for external session links (supports {session} and {issue} placeholders)

externalUrlLabel.description: Label for external session links (default: 'OpenClaw session')

enableAgentApi.description: Enable agent-callable API proxy endpoints (default: true)

apiBaseUrl.description: Override auto-detected base URL for agent API calls

apiCorsOrigins.description: Allowed origins for CORS on /plugins/linear/api (use ["*"] to allow any origin)

requireSessionAppUser.description: Require the AgentSessionEvent payload to include the session's appUser before dispatching. When true (default), events whose payload omits appUser are ignored (fail closed) so we never run for a session we can't confirm we own. Set false to allow them through (older webhook versions).

closeOnComplete.description: When the agent finishes successfully on a 'created' action, move the issue to the team's 'review' workflow state (the first state whose name contains 'review') for human sign-off. No-op if the team has no such state. (default: true)

dir.description: Local directory if already cloned (omit to let agent clone on demand)

repositories.description: Known repositories the agent can work in. Map of name → { cloneUrl, dir? }. Used for repo inference from issue context.

maxConcurrent.description: Maximum simultaneous agent runs. Excess runs are queued. (default: 3, max: 20)

githubOrg.description: GitHub organization name. If set, repos are auto-fetched and used with Linear's issueRepositorySuggestions to resolve the working directory for each issue.

githubRepoFilter.description: Optional substring filter for repo names. Only repos whose name contains this string are sent to the suggestion API. If no repos match, all active repos are used as fallback.

githubRepoMaxAgeDays.description: Maximum age in days since last push for repos to include as candidates. Archived repos and repos with no pushes are always excluded. (default: 365)

dispatchMode.description: Dispatch mode: 'embedded' (default, runEmbeddedAgent) or 'channel' (experimental channel reply pipeline).
